bug_semantics: A locally supplied truncated pcap (wire length greater than captured length) processed by tcprewrite --fixlen pad reaches untrunc_packet, which reallocates the packet buffer and may free its old address. tcpedit_packet has already cached packet and IP-header aliases into that old allocation and does not rebase them after untrunc_packet returns; its later DLT merge path calls dlt_en10mb_l2len/get_l2len/get_l2len_protocol through the stale packet address, producing the reported heap use-after-free read (and other post-padding paths could likewise use stale header aliases).
flaw_origin: Commit 69831b8186513309f4dd43ca5bacfc34b554ad14 changed untrunc_packet from padding the caller-provided buffer in place to safe_realloc(packet, pkthdr->len), and changed the API/caller to pass u_char **pktdata, but tcpedit_packet continued retaining its pre-call local packet, ip_hdr, and ip6_hdr aliases. In that original commit untrunc_packet did not even assign the new packet back through *pktdata; b58b23a52ffd23c3b1a2e2fe8b868aff0239560d later added *pktdata = packet but still did not rebase tcpedit_packet's cached aliases, so it did not cure the causal stale-pointer mechanism. The smallest first-writer is therefore 69831b8186513309f4dd43ca5bacfc34b554ad14, not the later headroom adjustment 64132c54c4000046b30f1fc3fe612db9b2f26860.
ai_marker: absent: git cat-file -p 69831b8186513309f4dd43ca5bacfc34b554ad14 shows author and committer Fred Klassen <fklassen@appneta.com>, one parent, and only the message 'remalloc packets before padding to ensure not overwriting memory - closes #80'; there are no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot, or other AI trailers/identities in the BIC commit object.
evidence: First-party advisory issue https://github.com/appneta/tcpreplay/issues/973 supplies the ASan chain: tcprewrite rewrite_packets -> tcpedit_packet -> untrunc_packet realloc -> tcpedit_dlt_merge_l3data -> dlt_en10mb_l2len -> get_l2len -> get_l2len_protocol, with the read at src/common/get.c:360 and the free at src/tcpedit/edit_packet.c:562 in 6fcbf0324088561d95c356fe8337f4faac275f1a. The related maintainer-tracked instance https://github.com/appneta/tcpreplay/issues/970 identifies the same untrunc_packet realloc root in the checksum path; maintainer fix 73008f261f1cdf7a1087dc8759115242696d35da is titled 'Bug #970 tcprewrite: --fixlen: do not use realloc' and its changelog explicitly says '--fixlen use-after-free (#970)'. git log -L 575,575:src/tcpedit/edit_packet.c 73008f261f1cdf7a1087dc8759115242696d35da^ and git log -S show that 69831b8186513309f4dd43ca5bacfc34b554ad14 first replaced in-place memset with packet = safe_realloc(packet, pkthdr->len); 64132c54c4000046b30f1fc3fe612db9b2f26860 only added PACKET_HEADROOM. Direct parent diff/tree verification against 16abc7fe749bd3c130204d0b2707caf7cab5894e shows untrunc_packet still accepted u_char *pktdata and performed only memset(pktdata + caplen, ...), with no realloc/free, so the UAF mechanism is absent at the immediate parent. Release ancestry checks show v4.0.4 (9ab0e75ca894ad48402265d524207e4e1e8734bb) excludes the BIC; v4.0.5 (4d25e6f59b0cdef57cbd3e910652babe362ea4eb), v4.5.1 (0ba7d17fcb9ddedf61168f99c249b30731310d4e), and v4.5.2-beta2 (a1778a25a2f8dc4de879782567abab6b923e9694) contain the BIC but not the fix. Direct fix 73008f261f1cdf7a1087dc8759115242696d35da removes safe_realloc, adds a pkthdr.len > MAX_SNAPLEN guard before copying into the already-MAXPACKET tcprewrite buffer, and changes configure.ac from 4.5.2-beta2 to 4.5.2-beta3; tagged v4.5.2 (98169912173986cc48a4ad325997dcc20c38af28) contains the fix. This matches the advisory boundary of affected through 4.5.1 and sufficient upgrade to 4.5.2-beta3.
reasoning: The vulnerability requires the realloc transition, not get_l2len_protocol itself: that parser is merely the observed stale-pointer consumer. History proves 69831b8186513309f4dd43ca5bacfc34b554ad14 is the atomic commit that first introduced realloc into the --fixlen pad branch while tcpedit_packet retained aliases established before the call. Its immediate parent cannot free or move pktdata on this path, establishing parent absence. Later commits changed pointer propagation and allocation headroom without removing the stale-alias hazard, and the flaw remained in every checked release from v4.0.5 through v4.5.1/v4.5.2-beta2. Commit 73008f261f1cdf7a1087dc8759115242696d35da fixes the root by eliminating the realloc and bounding wire length to the preallocated capacity, with its own version metadata marking 4.5.2-beta3 and the v4.5.2 tag containing it. The BIC is a normal single-parent commit, not a merge/squash/backport, so no decomposition is applicable. Finally, the BIC commit object has a human author/committer and no AI marker; under the required BIC-only attribution rule, the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
